newsitem.title: LATVIA: OLAINFARM SEES 1997 GROSS PROFIT 2.3 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: OLAINFARM SEES 1997 GROSS PROFIT 2.3 MLN LATS.

text.p: Latvian drug producer Olainfarm said on Friday that it expected a 1997 gross profit of 2.3 million lats.
Board chairman Egils Jurshevic also told a news conference that the company's profit in April was around 100,000 lats.
He also said the company planned to double production in 1997 back to its highest levels of 1991, which would make it the biggest drug maker in Latvia, beating rival Grindex.
He said the company badly needed investment to bring its production up to Western standards and the company would probably be forced to look for outside investors.
He said the company had received from the state privatision fund some 200,000 lats for investments, which he was satisfied with although the company had asked for 1.9 million lats.
Jurshevic said the company had already signed contracts for this year worth $12 million with leading Russian drug wholesalers.
